description: The plot illustrates the results of the shared Top-6 routed experts in two independent samples across six different tasks. The x-axis is labeled "Sample Token Count" and uses a base-2 logarithmic scale ranging from $2^9$ to $2^{20}$, with tick marks at every consecutive power of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Shared Experts for Two Samples" and uses a linear scale ranging from 2.0 to 6.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.5. The plot contains six solid lines without markers, representing different tasks as indicated by the legend. The orange line, representing "Intent," begins at approximately 3.7 at $2^9$, rises to 4.3 at $2^{10}$, dips to 3.9 at $2^{11}$, and then generally increases to end at approximately 5.9 at $2^{20}$. The blue line, representing "Summary," starts at roughly 2.1 at $2^9$, increases sharply to 4.5 at $2^{11}$, dips to 4.2 at $2^{12}$, and rises to finish near 5.9 at $2^{20}$. The yellow line, representing "Law," starts at 3.7 at $2^9$, peaks early at 5.2 at $2^{11}$, drops to 4.6 at $2^{12}$, and eventually climbs to approximately 5.9 at $2^{20}$. The purple line, representing "Translation," starts highest among the groups at 5.1 at $2^9$, dips to 4.8 at $2^{11}$, and rises to end near 5.9 at $2^{20}$. The green line, representing "Code," begins at 4.2 at $2^9$, drops to 4.3 at $2^{11}$ after an initial rise to 5.1 at $2^{10}$, and then trends upward to approximately 5.9 at $2^{20}$. Finally, the grey line, representing "Math," starts at the lowest value of 2.0 at $2^9$, rises to 3.7 at $2^{13}$, experiences a decline to 3.1 at $2^{14}$, and then steadily increases to end at approximately 5.9 at $2^{20}$. All six lines converge near a value of 5.9 by the end of the x-axis at $2^{20}$.
